blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: immediate — Operand is a literal value.
direct — Operand gives the memory location holding a value.
indirect — Operand points to a location holding the effective address.
indexed — Base address plus index gives effective address.

blocks.title: Immediate versus direct
blocks.text: LOAD #12 uses literal 12; LOAD 12 uses contents of memory[12].

blocks.title: Indirect addressing
blocks.text: LOAD @12 uses address stored in memory[12]; then loads data there.

blocks.title: Indexed addressing
blocks.text: LOAD 20,X uses effective address 20+X; useful for array elements.
